deploy-bot: kicking off config-only rollout: route="realtime"; soft_limit=120 -> 100? (we're increasing to 120), request_timeout=2200ms, rate_sculpt=0.85. Canary 5% for 15m during change window 23:00-01:00 UTC.
maria gonzalez: copying. I'll run the preflight sweep on the canary tenant set and monitor kvcache miss-rate + tail latencies.
raj patel: heads up: when we last bumped soft_limit we saw p99 tail on long-context generators. Watch p95/p99 separately.
samir: confirming this is config-only, no model version bump, yes?
maria gonzalez: correct — no model pin. We will pin routing rule to variant stable-2026-03 as fallback path.
lee: recommend adding a temporary circuit_breaker: auto-rollback if error rate increases by >12% vs baseline within 10m window.
maria gonzalez: added to staging config snippet: ```route: realtime
soft_limit: 120
request_timeout_ms: 2200
rate_sculpt: 0.85
auto_rollback_error_pct_delta: 12
monitoring_window_mins: 10
```
raj patel: sg. Add a line to release notes: "Config-only: route soft_limit/timeouts/rate-sculpt adjustment to smooth tail latencies"
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 5% at 1698765600. Health check: OK. 1m p50=180ms, p95=580ms, errors=0.2%.
ops-bot: alert created /ops/alerts/realtime-softlimit-1698765432 (watch p95, kvcache-miss-rate).
samir: plan to roll to 25% in 10m unless we hit rollback thresholds.
maria gonzalez: preflight completed for canary tenants, no kvcache pressure; proceeding.
deploy-bot: progressing to 25% at 1698765960. Health: p95=610ms, errors=0.3% (delta below 12% threshold). Slight tail increase but within bounds.
lee: monitoring long-tail generator tenant specifically. If we exceed error delta, we trigger rollback.
raj patel: I'll be on-call and watching logs/latency for 40m. ping @raj if anything spikes.
maria gonzalez: posted quick rollback steps and notes in #release-war-room. Added manual hold if any downstream backlog signs appear.
deploy-bot: global rollout complete at 1698766507. Final health: p95=590ms, errors=0.25%. No rollback triggered.
samir: nice. Filed follow-up ticket to tune rate_sculpt per tenant cohort next sprint. :thumbsup: 
maria gonzalez: scheduling a 15m retro with metrics tomorrow, will include tenant-specific traces and kvcache hit-rates.
